file_insights.details: Modified supplier_list view to use paginator.count instead of suppliers.count() for total supplier count

patterns_discovered.description: Replaced direct QuerySet count() method call with paginator's pre-calculated count property
patterns_discovered.benefit: Avoids redundant database queries when paginator object already has the count computed

patterns_discovered.description: Using cached paginator metadata instead of making additional database calls for context variables
patterns_discovered.benefit: Reduces database hit count and improves view performance

gotchas_discovered.description: QuerySet.count() executes a SELECT COUNT(*) query, while Paginator.count is already computed during pagination and available as a property
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: When paginator object is available, prefer using paginator.count to leverage already-computed value

approach_outcome.efficiency: High - Single line change with immediate performance benefit

recommendations.recommendation: Audit other views for similar patterns
recommendations.rationale: Other list views might have similar inefficiencies where QuerySet.count() is called after pagination
Document that paginator object should be preferred over additional QuerySet operations for count and page info

recommendations.recommendation: Consider using paginator in other context variables
recommendations.rationale: Review context dictionary for other potential optimization opportunities using paginator properties
